rationale: At 15:59 with zero minutes to close and automatic liquidation at the bell, any new position has no time to mature and would be flattened within seconds at an unpredictable closing print. Price has lifted off the lows into the upper half of the daily range and sits above both VWAP and the 5-minute 9-EMA on expanding volume, yet the session-ending mechanics override any readable edge in either direction.
